name: Hackney Church
address: St John at Hackney, Lower Clapton Rd, London
summary: St John at Hackney, the borough's parish church dating from 1792, is still a working church and since a multi-million-pound restoration has also been a large venue for concerts, arts and culture. Artists who have played include Ed Sheeran, Sampha and Biffy Clyro.

music.notes: Ticketed concerts, with standing room on the ground floor and unreserved pew seating up on the balcony. Most shows start at 7pm and are over by 11pm.

accessibility.notes: Wheelchair spaces and seats sit in a ground-floor access area near the stage, close to a disabled toilet; contact support@hackney.church before buying. Essential companions of ground-floor access ticket holders go free with proof. No lift to the balcony.

cost.notes: Card only: the venue takes no cash. Each ticket carries a £1 levy towards upkeep of the listed building.

age_policy: Varies by event; check each listing.

evidence.quote: HACKNEY CHURCH LIVE MUSIC AND EVENTS
Hackney Church, officially known as St John at Hackney, is the historic parish church of Hackney, dating back to 1792.
is outside the church grounds on Lower Clapton Road
Lower Clapton Road, London, E5 0PD
Following a multi-million-pound restoration, part-funded by the National Lottery Heritage Fund, the church has undergone a substantial transformation
Hackney Church functions as a premier venue for live music, arts and culture
the church has not only become a thriving place of worship, but also a vibrant centre for community engagement and cultural events
the 1800-capacity venue, equipped with state-of-the-art d&b audio system, has hosted performances by major artists such as Ed Sheeran, Sampha, Biffy Clyro and Joy Crookes
Most events at Hackney Church will begin at 7pm and finish by 11pm.
We are unable to provide Essential Companion tickets for customers who have purchased Ground Floor Standing or Balcony Unreserved Seating tickets.
Seating is reserved for balcony ticket holders only in unreserved pews.
Wheelchairs spaces are available in our Ground Floor Access Area.
Yes, all of our locations are accessible to the ground floor level.
Our Ground Floor Access Area is a seated area by the front of the stage with quick access to a disabled toilet.
Please get in touch with us via support@hackney.church before you purchase your tickets with your accessibility and Essential Companion requirements
We provide Essential Companion tickets free of charge (1 per person) for Ground Floor Accessibility ticket holders. If you would like to bring an Essential Companion please contact us with proof
Please note we do not have lifts to the Balcony
Hackney Church is a cashless venue and as such will not accept cash payments.
Hackney Church charges a restoration levy of £1.00 per ticket for the continued upkeep and preservation of our Grade II* listed building
Age restrictions for events at Hackney Church are dependent on the nature of the event. Please refer to the event for age restriction details.
